cost_basis.cheapest_design: The judge is called only for an attempt no rule covers, after the engine's report, and each ruling becomes a rule so the same attempt never calls the judge again; the judge uses the interpreter's cheap model and route. A cheaper design (no judge, unmatched attempts change nothing) is today's behaviour, which Brian's request replaces.
